description: Non-blocking lifecycle telemetry for work-slice worker and reviewer roles.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, runpy, subprocess, sys; root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip(); sys.argv = ['agent_flow_metrics.py', 'hook']; runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(root) / '.codex' / 'metrics' / 'agent_flow_metrics.py'), run_name='__main__')"
